scope: Stationary PMSM observer frequency responses, Eq. (15) normalization, q-axis lock, and averaged and ideal switched pulse tests.
critical_gaps: Original S-Function, injection settings and filter timing are not specified sufficiently for exact Figs. 10–13 reconstruction.
Fig. 9 vector readback verifies the lock category. Its plotted trace is about 0.88 electrical degrees from the ideal q axis.
The independent linear locked-rotor model has no polarity observability. Nonlinear or bench data are needed for the paper's polarity-detection step.

anomaly_evidence.finding: Eq. (15)'s printed expression is sqrt(2) times its current-norm definition. The reported threshold yields 3.534 electrical degrees near d when applied to the current-norm definition.
The 20 ms detector-only criterion can hold at the exact q-axis false lock with 90 electrical degrees of axis error.
